newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine unions to unite against Menem policy.
newsitem.headline: Argentine unions to unite against Menem policy.

text.p: Argentina's main labour federation CGT and maverick MTA union agreed Wednesday to fight together against President Carlos Menem's ecomomic policy, local agencies reported.
The CGT will hold on Thursday a meeting to set the date for a 36 hour general strike after they brought the country to a halt early August.
But CGT and MTA could not reach an agreement over a replacement for CGT's general secretary, Gerardo Martinez, who has announced that he will quit Thursday.

In an effort to close a fiscal gap estimated at $6.6 billion for this year the government has recently announced measures that have angered workers already worried by a 17.1 percent unemployment rate.
